description: This file defines a class 'TenantsTableConfigResolver' that configures and manages the tenant table in the UI, including columns, actions, and data fetching methods.

classes.name: TenantsTableConfigResolver
classes.description: A resolver class that provides configuration for the tenants table, including columns, actions, and data operations.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Returns the configured EntityTableConfig for tenants, setting the table title.

methods.name: openTenant
methods.description: Navigates to the tenant's detail page when a tenant row is opened.

methods.name: manageTenantAdmins
methods.description: Navigates to the tenant's admin management page.

methods.name: onTenantAction
methods.description: Handles tenant-specific actions such as opening details or managing admins.
